name: branding-emerald-fintech-design-system-sheet
title: Design system sheet: type specimen, six teal swatches and a browser hero
whatItIs: A pale sheet titled 'Design System' with a card showing Plus Jakarta Sans and a giant Aa, a grid of six named colour swatches with hex codes (black, midnight teal, teal green, medium aquamarine, pale aqua gray, white), and below a browser window with the teal hero 'Your Money Simplified' and three phones.
whatItMeans: Organised and calm; naming and coding every colour signals a mature system.
techniques: Show type, colour and a live page in one sheet.
Name each swatch and print its hex value inside it.
Use a giant Aa as the type moment.
Frame the applied page in a browser chrome.

vocabulary.definition: A colour block labelled with a friendly name and hex code.
An oversized sample of a typeface.
A real page shown next to the system rules.
A set of tones of teal from dark to pale.
